title: A numerical benchmark for fluid--structure--contact interaction
summary: We propose a two-dimensional benchmark for fluid-structure-contact interaction consisting of a deformable elastic disk falling under gravity within a viscous incompressible fluid and rebounding in the vicinity of the bottom wall. Solid deformability is essential, as rigid solids do not rebound in this framework. Besides this, the setting is deliberately kept simple to facilitate reproduction.
